import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 33;
    static final long mod = 1000000007;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] a = new long[N][N];
        int size;

        void toZero() {
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
                Arrays.fill(a[i], 0);
        }

        void toIdentity() {
            toZero();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
                a[i][i] = 1;
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix b) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix();
            res.size = size;
            res.toZero();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                        res.a[i][j] = (res.a[i][j] + a[i][k] * b.a[k][j]) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static long readLong(Scanner sc) {
        return sc.nextLong();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N_CONST = N;
        long MOD = mod;

        long n = readLong(sc);
        long K = readLong(sc);
        int r = (int) (K + 1);

        List<Matrix> one = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Matrix> two = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Matrix> rotr = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Matrix> rotc = new ArrayList<>();

        // Initialize 'one' matrices
        for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
            Matrix m = new Matrix();
            m.size = r;
            m.toZero();
            for (int j = 0; j < r; j++) {
                m.a[i][j] = 1;
            }
            if (i > 0) {
                for (int j = 0; j < r; j++) {
                    m.a[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
            one.add(m);
        }

        // Initialize 'rotr' matrices
        for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
            Matrix m = new Matrix();
            m.size = r;
            m.toZero();
            if (i == 1) {
                m.a[0][0] = 1;
                m.a[1][(int)K] = 1;
                for (int j = 2; j <= K; j++) {
                    m.a[j][j - 1] = 1;
                }
            } else if (i > 1) {
                m = rotr.get(1).multiply(rotr.get(i - 1));
            } else {
                m.toIdentity();
            }
            rotr.add(m);
        }

        // Initialize 'rotc' matrices
        for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
            Matrix m = new Matrix();
            m.size = r;
            m.toZero();
            if (i == 1) {
                m.a[0][0] = 1;
                m.a[(int)K][1] = 1;
                for (int j = 2; j <= K; j++) {
                    m.a[j - 1][j] = 1;
                }
            } else if (i > 1) {
                m = rotc.get(i - 1).multiply(rotc.get(1));
            } else {
                m.toIdentity();
            }
            rotc.add(m);
        }

        // Initialize 'two' matrices
        // For index 1
        Matrix twoMatrix = new Matrix();
        twoMatrix.size = r;
        twoMatrix.toIdentity();
        for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
            twoMatrix = one.get((int)i).multiply(twoMatrix);
        }
        // Fill 'two' list
        two.add(null); // 0-based placeholder
        two.add(twoMatrix);
        for (int i = 2; i < r; i++) {
            Matrix prev = two.get(i - 1);
            Matrix newMat = new Matrix();
            newMat.size = r;
            newMat.toIdentity();
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                newMat = rotr.get(j).multiply(prev).multiply(rotc.get(j)).multiply(prev);
            }
            two.add(newMat);
        }

        // Convert n to base K
        List<Long> num = new ArrayList<>();
        long tempN = n;
        while (tempN > 0) {
            num.add(tempN % K);
            tempN /= K;
        }
        Collections.reverse(num);

        // Build 'two' matrices for higher powers
        for (int i = 2; i < num.size(); i++) {
            Matrix prev = two.get(i - 1);
            Matrix newMat = new Matrix();
            newMat.size = r;
            newMat.toIdentity();
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                newMat = rotr.get(j).multiply(prev).multiply(rotc.get(j)).multiply(prev);
            }
            if (two.size() > i) {
                two.set(i, newMat);
            } else {
                two.add(newMat);
            }
        }

        // Multiply matrices according to the base-K representation
        Matrix result = new Matrix();
        result.size = r;
        result.toIdentity();

        int ps = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < num.size(); i++) {
            long count = num.get(i);
            if (i == num.size() - 1) {
                for (long j = 0; j < count; j++) {
                    result = one.get(ps % K + 1).multiply(result);
                    ps++;
                }
            } else {
                for (long j = 0; j < count; j++) {
                    result = rotr.get(ps % (int)K).multiply(two.get((int)(num.size() - i - 2))).multiply(rotc.get(ps % (int)K)).multiply(result);
                    ps++;
                }
            }
        }

        long res = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < r; j++) {
                res = (res + result.a[i][0]) % mod;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(res % mod);
        sc.close();
    }
}
